form_b.title: Handwriting and Spelling Lesson Structure and Components
form_b.structure_overview: This is FORM B - Structure of Major Part 1 Handwriting/Spelling
major_sections: Scripted Lesson Plan for Handwriting & Spelling

1_review_connect.name: Review & Connect
1_review_connect.purpose: The purpose of this part of the lesson is to start with a quick review of previously learned sounds. Do not use sounds that have not been directly taught. Do not use words that have sounds that have not been directly taught.

2_model_explain_engage.name: Model, Explain & Engage
2_model_explain_engage.purpose: The purpose of this part of the lesson is to connect a sound or sound patterns that you focused on during your reading block to writing its corresponding grapheme patterns. First, make sure children clearly can distinguish the targeted sound; then, hook that sound to the letter patterns through modeling and explaining the sequence of strokes for letters and correct order of letters.

3_guided_practice.name: Guided Practice
3_guided_practice.purpose: The purpose of this part of the lesson is to give children practice writing the letter while supporting proper pencil grip and correct sequence of stroke formation using handwriting lines.

4_application.name: Application
4_application.purpose: The purpose of this part of the lesson is to facilitate children's spelling of the letter or letter patterns when they hear the sound(s). This supports children's early coordination of matching sound to letter(s) for the purpose of spelling words.

5_wrap_up.name: Wrap-Up
5_wrap_up.purpose: The purpose of this part of the lesson is to remind students what they were focused on and provide praise for their accomplishments.

components_of_scripted_lesson.note: All 5 Subsections of 'Section D Scripted Lesson Plan for Handwriting & Spelling' will have the following components:

explanation.definition: AI explains the parts of the lesson

teacher_script.definition: Detailed example of what the teacher actually says as a rehearsal of the lesson

level_indicators.definition: Activities will be categorized as High, Middle, Low. For every activity indicate the child level ability

levels.low: an activity for children with low ability level
levels.middle: an activity for children with middle ability level
levels.high: an activity for children with high ability level

child_response.definition: Expected child response within the script
child_response.formatting: will be set off in parentheses ( )

teacher_does.definition: What the teacher is doing within the script
teacher_does.formatting: will be set off in curly brackets { }, also called braces

gesture.definition: a mnemonic device to support children's memory of a phoneme
gesture.requirement: You will always provide a gesture for phoneme sounds that are the focus of the Handwriting & Spelling lesson

sequence_verbal_cues.definition: verbal representations of the sequence of strokes for all letters in the alphabet
sequence_verbal_cues.requirement: You will always provide ##Sequence Verbal Cues for the handwriting of the target letter

adaptation.definition: AI prompts teacher request for activity examples, modifications according to child ability level
adaptation.adaptation_prompt: *Adaptation: Let me know if you would like activity examples, modifications of activities based on child ability level (low, middle, high).

modification.definition: modified teacher script # in response to teacher request
